# Hulwan Afif — Geospatial & LiDAR Specialist

> Field Data Processing Lead and geospatial specialist based in Singapore, working across mobile and terrestrial LiDAR, point-cloud processing, QC and delivery. Leads national-scale work covering 832,000+ trees and approximately 3,500 km of road for NParks Singapore, with project exposure in Malaysia, Brazil, Australia and Europe.

## Profile

- Name: Muhammad Hulwan Afif Bin Rajali
- Current role: Field Data Processing Lead / Delivery Manager, Greehill Asia-Pacific
- Location: Singapore
- Focus: mobile and terrestrial LiDAR, UAV mapping, 3D scanning, semantic extraction, geospatial QC, Scan-to-BIM and digital twins
- Experience: 8+ years across surveying, LiDAR and geospatial delivery
